methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The EnPI is obtained from a multiple linear model that relates the energy consumption with production and other operational variables such as added water, moisture after rest and particle size (PS)

paper_type.evidence_quote: The results of the study, carried out in a wheat mill plant in Cuba

level_3b.evidence_quote: The food industry is divided into several sectors. Among these, the wheat processing sector is considered as an energy-intensive industry consumer

stage1.notes: Case is a wheat mill / flour milling plant in Cuba (food industry). Runs round-the-clock (three shifts) as a continuous-flow process, but flour/grain milling is NOT on the closed Level-3B continuous-process sector list, so level_3b=false. type_of_organisation coded 'continuous process' as a Level-A descriptor only, independent of level_3b.

multi_site.evidence_quote: The wheat mill plant studied produces approximately 420 t of flour daily

country_region.evidence_quote: carried out in a wheat mill plant in Cuba

sector_of_activity.evidence_quote: the wheat processing sector is considered as an energy-intensive industry consumer

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: The reports are organized according to the work shifts of the plant (7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.), (3:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.) and (11:00 pm to 7:00 am.)

ems_standard.evidence_quote: According to ISO 50001 and ISO 50006 standards, several variables that affect the energy consumption can be introduced to obtain an EnPI

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: the energy consumption of wheat milling process using multiple linear regression
